author: IcyCode
body:
Hello,

The player The_Solo_Player has recently made this thread: https://avicus.net/forums/e8ee3acac. Now firstly he is encouraging other players to go onto his website and click on the adverts on there. This IS against the terms of conditions for google AdSense and therefore is attempting to make players break the law & he himself is breaking it. (I know this as I have used google adsense before). Now he has also offered a giveaway via his website. I have investigated this and I am unsure whether or not it is a scam. The form requires a user to enter there email address with no option to disable spam etc. therefore players who use this MAY recieve spam as a result of this.

I hope this issue can be resolved
